tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Premium. The deepest layer: behind the window, scrims, the app icon base and specimen boards. Only `app` and shadows sit on it.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Sunk areas: fader grooves, meter backgrounds, the segmented control's trough, text fields. Always darker than the surface it is cut into, in both themes (theme.rs `well`).

tokens.name: app
tokens.usage: Window, panels and the transport bar: the base every other surface steps from. Text on it: `text`, `text_secondary`.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Arrangement and editor background. Text on it: `text`, `text_secondary`.

tokens.name: lane
tokens.usage: Lane background behind clips and notes.

tokens.name: header
tokens.usage: Track header column and the detail panel's toolbars.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Ruler, strips, cards and inputs one step above `app`. Text on it: `text`, `text_secondary`.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, windows and the command palette: the only surfaces that float. Pair with `border_strong` and egui's window shadow (offset 0,6, blur 18, black at 38%).

tokens.name: clip_body
tokens.usage: A clip's body behind its waveform or notes; the track colour carries the title bar.

tokens.name: selected_row
tokens.usage: A selected track header, tinted toward the accent. Text on it: `text`.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: A control at rest (the bottom of its fill). Letters on it: `text_secondary` at rest, `text` when chosen.

tokens.name: control_hi
tokens.usage: Premium. The top of a raised control's fill: a two-stop vertical gradient mesh, `control_hi` to `control`, a 3% step. Never used flat.

tokens.name: thumb_hi
tokens.usage: Premium. Top of the chosen piece of a segmented control or tab pill: the raised thumb in the well.

tokens.name: thumb
tokens.usage: Premium. Bottom of that thumb. Letters on it: `text`.

tokens.name: control_hover
tokens.usage: egui's hovered fill for flat controls not yet painted with `raised()` (`theme::controls().hover`). Raised controls, menu rows and segmented pieces lay `ember` over their fill instead; tabs only brighten their letters.

tokens.name: control_press
tokens.usage: A control held down; the filled part of a slider; switch pill.

tokens.name: selected_control
tokens.usage: Controls on a selected row, stepped up so they keep their edge on the blue selection.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Separators, panel edges and a raised control's 1 pt outline.

tokens.name: border_strong
tokens.usage: Window and popover outlines, hovered fields.

tokens.name: edge_light
tokens.usage: Premium. A 1 pt line painted along the top inside edge of every raised surface (`painter.hline`, inside the rounded rect). 7% white on dark, 80% on light.

tokens.name: shade
tokens.usage: Premium. A 1 pt line painted along the top inside edge of a well or a pressed control: the lip that makes it read as sunk. 50% black on dark, 14% ink on light.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: Light level 1. A wash laid over what the pointer is on: 8% of the text colour. Hover on raised controls, ruler halves, list rows.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `app`, `canvas`, `raised`, `overlay`, `control` and `selected_row` (7:1 or better on all).

tokens.name: text_secondary
tokens.usage: Labels and unlit control letters on `app`, `canvas`, `raised`, `overlay`, `header` and `control` (4.5:1 or better).

tokens.name: text_hint
tokens.usage: Hints, empty-state captions, units and meter scales. Source value, kept exact: 3.1 to 3.8:1 on dark surfaces and 2.8 to 3.3:1 on light ones, so it never carries a fact the user needs; pair it with an icon or a nearby `text_secondary` line.

tokens.name: text_disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls only (exempt from contrast by WCAG; always with a reason on hover).

tokens.name: on_accent
tokens.usage: Premium. Text and icons on a filled accent control (`accent_hi` to `accent_lo` gradient): 5.4:1 or better in dark, 4.6:1 or better in light.

tokens.name: text_on_light
tokens.usage: Text on any light fill chosen by lightness (`theme::text_on`), such as a return's letter badge.

tokens.name: clip_text
tokens.usage: Clip names on the 12 clip colours (3:1 or better on each).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The single accent: active, selected, playing, focus. Text and icons on `app`, `canvas` and `raised` (4.1:1 or better; 4.4 on `app` in light, kept exact).

tokens.name: accent_hi
tokens.usage: Premium. Top of a filled accent control. Text on it: `on_accent`.

tokens.name: accent_lo
tokens.usage: Premium. Bottom of a filled accent control. Text on it: `on_accent`.

tokens.name: accent_muted
tokens.usage: Background of an active toggle, tab pill or chosen row, with `accent` letters (4.4:1 dark, 3.9:1 light: kept exact; bold or 13 pt and up).

tokens.name: record
tokens.usage: Record, and nothing else: arm, a clip light, recording state. The one light besides the accent.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Problems that need attention (device lost, dropouts). Text on `app` and `overlay`. Never glows.

tokens.name: mute
tokens.usage: A lit M (mute) button. Text on it: `on_mute`.

tokens.name: on_mute
tokens.usage: Letters on a lit mute button.

tokens.name: core
tokens.usage: The centre of a light (Beam): white on dark, the accent itself on light, where light is ink, not glow.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: The logo's sun rim. Used for the mark and its empty states only.

tokens.name: sun_core
tokens.usage: The logo's sun centre.

tokens.name: grid_bar
tokens.usage: Bar lines.

tokens.name: grid_beat
tokens.usage: Beat lines.

tokens.name: grid_sub
tokens.usage: Lines between beats.

tokens.name: start_marker
tokens.usage: Where Play starts: neutral, so it never reads as the playhead.

tokens.name: clip_1
tokens.usage: Track and clip colour 1 (steel). Muted, mid lightness; the same in both themes so content keeps its identity.

tokens.name: clip_2
tokens.usage: Track and clip colour 2 (violet). Muted, mid lightness; the same in both themes so content keeps its identity.

tokens.name: clip_3
tokens.usage: Track and clip colour 3 (sage). Muted, mid lightness; the same in both themes so content keeps its identity.

tokens.name: clip_4
tokens.usage: Track and clip colour 4 (ochre). Muted, mid lightness; the same in both themes so content keeps its identity.

tokens.name: clip_5
tokens.usage: Track and clip colour 5 (rose). Muted, mid lightness; the same in both themes so content keeps its identity.

tokens.name: clip_6
tokens.usage: Track and clip colour 6 (teal). Muted, mid lightness; the same in both themes so content keeps its identity.

tokens.name: clip_7
tokens.usage: Track and clip colour 7 (periwinkle). Muted, mid lightness; the same in both themes so content keeps its identity.

tokens.name: clip_8
tokens.usage: Track and clip colour 8 (plum). Muted, mid lightness; the same in both themes so content keeps its identity.

tokens.name: clip_9
tokens.usage: Track and clip colour 9 (moss). Muted, mid lightness; the same in both themes so content keeps its identity.

tokens.name: clip_10
tokens.usage: Track and clip colour 10 (clay). Muted, mid lightness; the same in both themes so content keeps its identity.

tokens.name: clip_11
tokens.usage: Track and clip colour 11 (sky). Muted, mid lightness; the same in both themes so content keeps its identity.

tokens.name: clip_12
tokens.usage: Track and clip colour 12 (taupe). Muted, mid lightness; the same in both themes so content keeps its identity.

tokens.name: clip_muted
tokens.usage: A muted clip: its colour drains to this grey.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Premium. Welcome and first-run screens only.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Panel titles (Browser). Unbounded is wide: short titles only.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: "Lumen" in the transport bar. Never redrawn, never re-cased.

styles.name: keycap
styles.usage: The letters on K5 keycaps (`widgets/keys.rs`: the caption size in Inter, kept exactly). In tooltips, menu rows, the palette and the shortcuts window; never on a button.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: The master's integrated loudness: the one figure read from across the room.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Position, tempo, CPU: anything that changes while you read it. Set at width 87.5.

styles.name: mono_small
styles.usage: Ruler numbers, piano-roll key labels, clip meta (8 bars, 17 notes).

tokens.name: space_xxs
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: inside a segmented control, between a strip's rails.

tokens.name: space_xs
tokens.usage: Between icon and label; between a knob row's items; pad inside chips.

tokens.name: space_s
tokens.usage: Between controls; content inset in strips; menu padding.

tokens.name: space_m
tokens.usage: Window and card insets; above a section heading; a tab's side padding; a menu row's gap before its keycaps.

tokens.name: space_l
tokens.usage: Panel toolbar insets; around an empty state's parts.

tokens.name: space_xl
tokens.usage: Premium. Between groups in a panel; welcome and first-run layouts.

tokens.name: space_2xl
tokens.usage: Premium. Section gaps in documentation and first-run screens.

tokens.name: radius_sm
tokens.usage: 20 pt controls and the 20 pt segmented trough, clips, notes, keycaps, chips inside 20 pt rows.

tokens.name: radius_md
tokens.usage: 24 pt controls, inputs, menu items. Premium: buttons move here from 4.

tokens.name: radius_lg
tokens.usage: 30 pt controls, the tool switch's trough, popovers and menus.

tokens.name: radius_xl
tokens.usage: Premium. Windows, cards, the command palette, floating panels. The app icon uses 22.5% of its side.

tokens.name: radius_full
tokens.usage: Pills (egui clamps the radius to half the height): switches, lane tabs, the dropout chip.

tokens.name: size_control_sm
tokens.usage: M, S and arm on headers, switches, segmented controls, header sliders: dense rows.

tokens.name: size_control
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, sliders and combos. The default.

tokens.name: size_control_lg
tokens.usage: Premium. Detail-panel toolbars: the tool switch (a 30 pt segmented control), grid chip, icon buttons; transport readouts.

tokens.name: size_knob_sm
tokens.usage: Knobs in lists (a return's senders).

tokens.name: size_knob
tokens.usage: Send knobs on headers and strips.

tokens.name: size_transport_icon
tokens.usage: Transport icon buttons.

tokens.name: size_info_line
tokens.usage: The info line along the bottom of the window.

tokens.name: size_track_step
tokens.usage: Track heights move in 22 pt steps: folded 44, unfolded 88 to 308.

tokens.name: size_header_column
tokens.usage: Default track header column (resizable, 480 at most).

tokens.name: size_label_column
tokens.usage: A window's right-aligned label column.

tokens.name: size_label_column_narrow
tokens.usage: The label column of a narrow card (clip properties).

tokens.name: duration_fast
tokens.usage: Hover and press feedback, ease-out; lit buttons cross-fading; a highlight following the arrow keys.

tokens.name: duration_base
tokens.usage: Popovers, windows, notices and panels appearing or leaving.

tokens.name: duration_glide
tokens.usage: Things moving to a new place, by the critically damped spring (`motion::glide`, omega 7, no overshoot): the playhead after a locate, clips settling, the tab underline, a segmented thumb.

tokens.name: duration_wash
tokens.usage: What undo or redo changed: an accent wash that fades.

tokens.name: duration_note
tokens.usage: How long a short note (undo, save, open) stays before it fades.

tokens.name: duration_breath
tokens.usage: The armed ring's slow breath: the one deliberate loop. Reduce motion holds it still.

tokens.name: stroke_hairline
tokens.usage: Separators, outlines and the edge-light and shade lines: 1 pt, pixel-snapped.

tokens.name: stroke_lit
tokens.usage: The crisp line of a Lit or Flare light.

tokens.name: stroke_focus
tokens.usage: The keyboard focus ring, and the line of a Beam.

tokens.name: stroke_core
tokens.usage: A Beam's white core, drawn inside its 2 pt line.
